content: HF Spaces has three storage tiers: ephemeral Space disk (free, wiped on rebuild/restart), paid Persistent Storage (a mounted disk), and Hub repos (models/datasets/spaces) which are free, git-versioned and unlimited but explicitly 'not meant to be used as a database'. huggingface_hub's CommitScheduler batches background uploads to reduce concurrency errors but the docs still warn about pushing empty commits or duplicate data; the underlying dataset repo is a git repo so concurrent commits from two Space replicas/sessions can race, and heavy concurrent job access to shared HF cache/dataset files is a documented source of concurrency errors in huggingface/datasets issues.
